OpenAI's new ChatGPT Admin plugin allows workspace administrators to manage users and permissions directly from conversations, analyse usage, and generate reports. Details below.

The Admin plugin operates within the scope of account permissions

OpenAI today announced the launch of the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex, a new tool that allows workspace administrators to update settings, ask questions, and generate reports based on workspace usage and activity data.

OpenAI stated:

Through the Admin plugin, administrators can complete daily tasks directly within ChatGPT Work and Codex, including but not limited to: Understanding adoption and usage. Reviewing activity and credit usage in ChatGPT Work and Codex to identify areas that may need additional support, as well as which members or groups are approaching credit limits. Managing members and groups. Adding or removing members, updating groups, and handling routine onboarding, offboarding, and team changes. Managing access and permissions. Reviewing effective permissions, diagnosing access issues, and controlling access to features or models by role or group. Managing usage limits and spending requests. Adjusting caps for members, groups, and workspaces, reviewing requests based on current usage, and approving or rejecting them with the relevant information at hand.

In a demonstration of the new plugin, OpenAI GTM employee Aarti Bagul showed a use case: she was preparing her monthly AI implementation review. She asked ChatGPT Work how adoption and credit usage across teams had changed over the past 30 days, then requested a chart highlighting the biggest changes.

During the demonstration, she analysed trends, requested further breakdowns and explanations, approved usage requests, and finally had ChatGPT create a presentation to share in a Slack channel.

OpenAI emphasised that potential applications for this new Admin plugin include automating repetitive management tasks, scaling existing governance mechanisms, and supporting internal IT operations.

The Admin plugin is now available in the Plugins directory of ChatGPT Work.
